description: Re-check findings after deploying a fix. Fetches the live page once per check, with no analysis and no credit, and answers verified, still_failing or unverifiable per finding. Use this instead of re-running analyze_website. Pass exactly one of report_id, domain_id or site_analysis_id, and optionally the finding ids to check. Included with Pro and Agency.

domain_id.description: Domain ID, for its latest site analysis

finding_ids.description: Finding ids from get_findings. Omit to check them all.

report_id.description: Report ID whose findings to re-check

name: verify_findings
title: Check whether fixes landed
